const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Live RGB/depth and proprio based controller for the current RoboCasa GR1 episode.
+
+The object and receptacle targets are taken from the service's calibrated camera images.
+No simulator internals, task state, demonstrations, or reset endpoint are used.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+DT = 0.05
+BASE_T = np.array([2.66261, -2.15254, 0.88087])
+# World to base rotation is the transpose of [[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]].
+
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - BASE_T
+    return np.array([p[1], -p[0], p[2]])
+
+
+def base_to_world(p):
+    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
+    return BASE_T + np.array([-p[1], p[0], p[2]])
+
+
+def capture(r, label):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=["egoview", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand"], include_depth=True, video="none")
+    out = f"/app/output/{label}"
+    o.save(out)
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "meta": {k: o.meta.get(k) for k in ("control_steps", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")},
+                      "proprio": o.meta["proprio"]["now"][-30:]}, indent=2))
+    print("saved", out)
+    return o
+
+
+def command_from_obs(o):
+    layout = o.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    d = dict(zip(layout, now))
+    a = np.zeros(24, dtype=float)
+    for i, side in ((0, "right"), (6, "left")):
+        for j, axis in enumerate(("x", "y", "z", "rx", "ry", "rz")):
+            a[i+j] = d[f"cmd_{side}_{axis}"]
+    for i, side in ((12, "right"), (18, "left")):
+        for j, finger in enumerate(("little", "ring", "middle", "index", "thumb_flexion", "thumb_rotation")):
+            a[i+j] = d[f"cmd_{side}_{finger}"]
+    return a, d
+
+
+def run_path(r, targets, seconds=2.0, label="move"):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=["egoview"], include_depth=False, video="none")
+    start, d = command_from_obs(o)
+    end = start.copy()
+    for side, p_world in targets.items():
+        ofs = 0 if side == "right" else 6
+        end[ofs:ofs+3] = world_to_base(p_world)
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
+    rows = np.stack([start + (end-start)*(k+1)/n for k in range(n)])
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=DT, interpolate="hold", cameras=["egoview", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand", "robot0_eye_in_right_hand"], video="none", note=label)
+    result.save(f"/app/output/{label}")
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "meta": {k: result.meta.get(k) for k in ("control_steps", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason", "executed_rows")},
+                      "right_world": base_to_world(end[0:3]).tolist(), "left_world": base_to_world(end[6:9]).tolist(),
+                      "hand_cmds": end[12:].tolist()}, indent=2))
+    return result
+
+
+def run_hand(r, side, values, seconds=0.6, label="hand"):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=["egoview"], include_depth=False, video="none")
+    start, _ = command_from_obs(o)
+    end = start.copy()
+    i = 12 if side == "right" else 18
+    end[i:i+6] = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
+    rows = np.stack([start + (end-start)*(k+1)/n for k in range(n)])
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=DT, interpolate="hold", cameras=["egoview", f"robot0_eye_in_{side}_hand"], video="none", note=label)
+    result.save(f"/app/output/{label}")
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "meta": {k: result.meta.get(k) for k in ("control_steps", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")},
+                      "hand_cmds": end[i:i+6].tolist()}, indent=2))
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="op", required=True)
+    sub.add_parser("inspect")
+    mv = sub.add_parser("move", help="move one or both grip sites to world XYZ")
+    mv.add_argument("--right", nargs=3, type=float)
+    mv.add_argument("--left", nargs=3, type=float)
+    mv.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, default=2.0)
+    mv.add_argument("--label", default="move")
+    gr = sub.add_parser("hand", help="set six Fourier hand commands")
+    gr.add_argument("side", choices=("left", "right"))
+    gr.add_argument("values", nargs=6, type=float)
+    gr.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, default=0.6)
+    gr.add_argument("--label", default="hand")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    r = Robot()
+    if args.op == "inspect":
+        o = capture(r, "current")
+        print("status", json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
+    elif args.op == "move":
+        targets = {k: getattr(args, k) for k in ("right", "left") if getattr(args, k) is not None}
+        if not targets:
+            ap.error("provide --right and/or --left")
+        run_path(r, targets, args.seconds, args.label)
+    elif args.op == "hand":
+        run_hand(r, args.side, args.values, args.seconds, args.label)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
